status: Source-prefix model-family development only; no future metric may be opened by this protocol.
claim_boundary: Passing can admit an exploratory released-cohort run. It cannot establish a SOTA claim without a separately locked independent cohort.

evidence_boundary.validation_interval: remaining 25 percent of the released observation prefix
evidence_boundary.future_controller_values: not required by the source gate and omitted

method.partition: causal-dino-graph-voronoi-parts-v1 from the previously locked fit-prefix proxy
method.object_groups: unique unordered endpoint-part pairs, including separate cross-part groups
method.parameterization: additive continuous group log scales around the teacher

family_gate.reference: zero-update exact-teacher trajectory from the same part-pair runner
family_gate.score: equal mean of candidate/teacher CD and track-error ratios

source_acceptance.aggregate_metrics: learned-or-teacher selected stack must improve both validation CD and validation track error
source_acceptance.mechanism_diagnostic: report within-part, cross-part, and controller log scales; uniform movement is not evidence for piecewise mechanics
source_acceptance.identity_requirement: zero-update part-pair runs reproduce their exact teacher within the measured Warp replay floor

forbidden: future-frame objective, checkpoint selection, or metric inspection
retuning groups, learning rate, regularization, or source cases after validation
calling a passing released-cohort result independent or confirmatory
calling continuous part-pair scaling a reproduction of NeuSpring topology optimization
